title: Nonstationary temporal estimator and same-endpoint refinement seam audit

A01.finding: Checkpoint, trial isolation, rollback and hard mass accounting are structurally compatible with repeated same-origin characterization trials.

A02.finding: Outer retry shortening changes the physical comparison endpoint and therefore cannot be treated as another level of fixed-horizon temporal refinement.

A03.finding: F-CI14 already fixes endpoint metric categories and scalarization. F-SI21 must not replace this with an FGC02-specific raw-head-only acceptance contract.

A04.finding: A same-endpoint nested refinement candidate can be implemented as test-only characterization by repeatedly cloning one physical checkpoint, restoring its worker attempt context, and executing multiple partitions that all terminate at the same target endpoint.

A05.finding: Production adoption of a same-endpoint internal refinement ladder changes the transaction lifecycle and diagnostics semantics. F-KT owns that canonical API and lifecycle. F-SI21 may characterize the algorithm but may not unilaterally alter production transaction semantics.

A06.finding: Independent numerical temporal limits and scientific admission remain F-VQ responsibilities. F-SI21 may produce characterization evidence, not final tolerance values.

A07.finding: A naive always-on 1+2+4 same-endpoint hierarchy costs seven physical solves and would conflict with the bounded normal-path coupling/performance objective. Candidate design must distinguish a cheap normal path from bounded escalation or reference-only work.

A08.finding: The universally reachable N256 level observed in F-VQ28 is useful as a characterization level but is not a scientific oracle merely because N512 has five convergence-ceiling failures.

invariant_assessment.7: PASS: test-only characterization can start every level from the same committed checkpoint without publication of failed trials
invariant_assessment.8: PASS: repeated same-origin replay is directly supported by clone and attempt-context restore
invariant_assessment.9: PASS: candidate is defined on generic [t0,t1] endpoints, not calendar days
invariant_assessment.13: PASS_WITH_GATE: every candidate level retains hard mass diagnostics and no mass tolerance relaxation is permitted
invariant_assessment.15: OPEN_GATE: naive seven-solve hierarchy is too expensive as a mandatory normal production path
invariant_assessment.23: PASS: estimator policy remains numerical configuration, not physics
invariant_assessment.24: OPEN_GATE: bounded escalation and fallback behavior must be characterized
invariant_assessment.25: PASS_WITH_HOLD: reference mode remains available, but the finite oracle for difficult short horizons is unresolved
invariant_assessment.26: OPEN_GATE: refinement level, branch, cost and mass diagnostics must be first-class before production adoption
invariant_assessment.30: PASS_FOR_AUDIT: owner boundaries and invariant impacts are explicit

next_action: Freeze a source-bound algorithmic candidate matrix for same-endpoint nested refinement before executing numerical characterization. Do not select production tolerances or modify transaction production source.
